changed.title: At most 500k·2^max(19,⌊k/2⌋) AND/OR/NOT gates of fan-in at most two for the three-round key test on two k-bit names, k ≥ 20
changed.statement:
∀ k : Nat, 20 ≤ k →
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let first := fun (rowKey rowName : Nat) =>
    (List.range 3).foldl (fun state i =>
      step (state ^^^ rot 1 state ^^^ rot (k - 1) state) ^^^
        rot (2 * i) rowKey ^^^ constant (i + 1)) (rot 1 rowKey ^^^ rowName)
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range 3).foldl (fun state i =>
      step (state ^^^ rot 2 state ^^^ rot (k - 2) state) ^^^
        rot (3 * (i + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (3 + (i + 1))) (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let low := k - (k + 1) / 2
  let graph : Fin (2 ^ k) → Fin (2 ^ k) → Bool := fun row col =>
    (List.range (2 ^ k)).any (fun w =>
      decide (first w row.val < 2 ^ low) && decide (second w col.val < 2 ^ low))
  ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (k + k) C ∧
    C.size ≤ 2 ^ max 19 low * (500 * k) ∧
    ∀ bits : Fin (k + k) → Bool,
      C.eval (List.ofFn bits) = PEqualNP.Represents.adjFun (k := k) (l := k) graph bits
changed.unlocks: a ceiling for the candidate rule cut to three rounds, the one round count the row-side slots cannot do, for the line that says which round counts are cheap
changed.context: On paper. Put z = rot3(w) xor v. Fix 19 seed bits and every bit left outside the sweep. Descend through the top h column equations. At bit i the state term reads only z[i-6..i+12]. The key contributes z[i-7] alone. Wire a fresh pivot from that equation, or compare it with its seed bit on a wrap. Recover w from z and v, test the row on w and u, then OR all accepting slots. Count 815 gates per pivot computation, five per comparison and 65k for key recovery and the row rounds. The total fits 500k gates per slot including joins.

changed.title: A Boolean rule that determines each later bit from its prefix has exactly one completion per free prefix
changed.statement:
∀ (free forced : ℕ)
  (rule : (i : Fin forced) → (Fin free → Bool) → (Fin i.val → Bool) → Bool),
  let freeBits := fun (word : Fin (free + forced) → Bool) (a : Fin free) =>
    word (Fin.castAdd forced a)
  let passes := fun (word : Fin (free + forced) → Bool) =>
    ∀ i : Fin forced, word (Fin.natAdd free i) =
      rule i (freeBits word)
        (fun j => word (Fin.natAdd free (Fin.castLE (Nat.le_of_lt i.isLt) j)))
  ∃ complete : (Fin free → Bool) ≃ { word // passes word },
    (∀ seed word, freeBits word.val = seed ↔ word = complete seed) ∧
    Nat.card { word // passes word } = 2 ^ free
changed.unlocks: counting all keys from the free bits in the one-round and two-round rules
changed.context: On paper. Fix the free prefix. Recursively assign each forced bit from the free prefix and the earlier forced bits. Apply the recursion equation at each forced index to verify the rule. Taking its free prefix recovers the seed. For the other inverse, induct on the forced index. A passing word and the word rebuilt from its prefix have identical earlier bits, so the rule prescribes the same next bit. Transfer cardinality across this equivalence and count Boolean functions on Fin f. The empty prefix gives one completion.

changed.title: Deleting a row on the one-a-side promise saves marked readers in fan-in-two AND/OR circuits, also with NOT gates
changed.statement:
∀ (n m : ℕ) (A : Fin (n + 1) → Fin m → Bool) (u : Fin (n + 1))
    (C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit) (K : Finset (Fin C.gates.length)),
  let N := n + 1 + m
  let reads := fun (g : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Gate) (w : ℕ) =>
    (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ g.inputs.head? = some w) ∨
    (g.op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not ∧ w ∈ g.inputs)
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C →
  PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack N C →
  PEqualNP.Represents.Represents A C →
  (∃ x : List Bool, x.length = N ∧ x.getD u.val false = false ∧ C.eval x = false) →
  (∀ j ∈ K, reads (C.gates.get j) u.val ∨
    ∃ i : Fin C.gates.length, i < j ∧ reads (C.gates.get i) u.val ∧
      ((C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.and ∨
       (C.gates.get i).op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not) ∧
      reads (C.gates.get j) (N + i.val)) →
  ∃ D : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit,
    D.size + K.card ≤ C.size ∧
    PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun a c => A (u.succAbove a) c) D ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo D ∧
    (PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 C → PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.Monotone2 D) ∧
    PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.NestedCover.ReadsBack (n + m) D ∧
    (∀ g ∈ D.gates,
      (g.op = PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not → g.inputs.length = 1) ∧
      (g.op ≠ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.GateOp.not →
        g.inputs.length = 2 ∧ g.inputs.Nodup)) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin D.gates.length, n + m + i.val ≠ D.output →
      ∃ j : Fin D.gates.length, i < j ∧ reads (D.gates.get j) (n + m + i.val))
changed.unlocks: pays for two gates in the deletion branch for incomparable rows on the one-row, one-column promise
changed.context: Fix the deleted input to false. Track each old wire as a constant or a relocated wire. Fold a direct reader to a constant or a copy. A direct AND becomes false and a direct NOT becomes true, so their readers fold too. Induct on gate prefixes: emitted gates plus marked gates seen never exceed the old length. The false witness rules out constant true at the output. For false use an absent wire. Otherwise keep the output cone. Compact its gates, remove the input, and shift column indices. Evaluate on each surviving row and column.

changed.title: For r ≥ 3 and k ≥ 7r - 1, at most 2^max(floor(k/2),7r - 2) keys pass the second test at any fixed k-bit column
changed.statement:
∀ (k r : Nat), 3 ≤ r → 7 * r - 1 ≤ k → ∀ v : Fin (2 ^ k),
  let rot := fun (s word : Nat) =>
    ((word <<< (s % k)) ||| (word >>> (k - s % k))) % 2 ^ k
  let step := fun (word : Nat) =>
    (List.range k).foldl (fun acc i =>
      acc ||| ((xor (word.testBit i)
        (!(word.testBit ((i + 1) % k)) && word.testBit ((i + 2) % k))).toNat <<< i)) 0
  let constant := fun (j : Nat) => 3 ^ (k + j) % 2 ^ k
  let second := fun (colKey colName : Nat) =>
    (List.range r).foldl (fun colState colIndex =>
      step (colState ^^^ rot 2 colState ^^^ rot (k - 2) colState) ^^^
        rot (3 * (colIndex + 1) + 1) colKey ^^^ constant (r + (colIndex + 1)))
      (rot 3 colKey ^^^ colName)
  let h := (k + 1) / 2
  ((List.range (2 ^ k)).filter (fun w => decide (second w v.val < 2 ^ (k - h)))).length
    ≤ 2 ^ (max (k - h) (7 * r - 2))
changed.unlocks: Bounds the number of keys a column can admit from three rounds onward, for the column-side circuit construction.
changed.context: On paper. Fix v and write z = rot3(w) XOR v, a bijection. Each round reads previous offsets -2 through 4 and adds z at offset 2-3t. Inductively the left reach after t rounds is at most max(2t,3t-2), the right reach 4t. At r >= 3 the last key supplies z[p] at p=i-(3r-2), before a window z[p+1..p+L] with L=7r-2. Sweep down the h tested bits. The initial q=min(h,k-L) pivots are fresh. Equal bits off these pivots force equal pivot bits in order for passing words. Later cyclic checks can only discard assignments. Count the 2^(k-q) choices off the pivots.

Later cyclic checks can only discard assignments. Count the 2^(k-q) choices off the pivots.

changed.statement: PEqualNP.Represents.RepSizeAtMost (fun (u : Fin 4) (v : Fin 6) => (841068 : ℕ).testBit (6 * u.val + v.val)) 12
changed.unlocks: the AND/OR cost of 4 by 6 graphs off the square, where the checked twin merge sends square graphs, for the silent-line work
changed.sketch: A search unit. We hold a circuit of 13 AND/OR gates (three plain forms, full lines taken out, equal gates merged and unread gates dropped); at this size those forms are weak; we hold none of 12; this is a search. Answer with a gate list (AND or OR, each reading at most two wires; wires 0 to 3 left, 4 to 9 right, gate j writes wire 10 + j, each gate reading only earlier wires) and its output wire, judged on all 24 inputs with one vertex on each side.

changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 8 ∧ ∀ i j : Fin 6, C.eval (List.ofFn fun k : Fin 6 => decide (k = i ∨ k = j)) = (34630323643 : ℕ).testBit (6 * min i.val j.val + max i.val j.val)

changed.sketch: We hold a circuit of 9 gates, a weak hand form (best over a few point orders and the complement plus a NOT, equal gates merged): OR(4,5), OR(1,6), AND(3,7), OR(0,6), AND(2,9), AND(4,5), OR(8,10), OR(11,12), NOT(13) (inputs 0-5 are the points, gate k is wire 6 + k, output last). We hold no circuit of 8 gates; this is a search. No complete search of ours has run at six points.
